game.name: [FISH FUSION 🧬] FISH OS - RETRO COMPUTER FISHING

features:
🎣 FishOS A251 Premium Hub

A highly optimized, crash-proof auto-farming script for FishOS. Built from the ground up to bypass rendering bugs on limited executors (like Potassium and Solara), this script uses native Lua coroutines to run massive background automation without ever freezing your game.

✨ Key Features:

🐟 Advanced Farming: Lightning-fast Auto-Fish and a memory-bypassing Auto-Catch that never misses a bobber.

💰 Smart Economy: Automated fish selling with a customizable minimum price multiplier to maximize your profits.

🚀 Progression Maxing: Auto-Upgrades (1-10), Auto-Prestige, and Auto-Claim all achievements.

⚓ Fleet Management: Thread-safe Auto Buy Best Equipment that upgrades all 20 boats simultaneously without lagging the server.

🌊 Expedition Mastery: Automatically loops Abyss Dives across all 10 slots.

🛡️ Premium Key System: Gorgeous custom-animated Pre-Loader UI that safely verifies your Junkie API key, auto-saves it to your executor for seamless future logins, and easily redirects users to your Discord.

⚙️ Technical Perks: Powered by the reliable Rayfield UI, featuring Anti-AFK, customizable background loop delays for low-end PCs, and bulletproof executor compatibility. Just execute, enter your key once, and let the script do the heavy lifting!
